games.title: Feel a little better
games.intro: A few minutes of something gentle can lift a low moment.

breathe.title: Breathe
breathe.ready: Tap Start and follow the circle

bubbles.title: Bubble pop
bubbles.body: Pop bubbles, let go of stress

memory.title: Memory match
memory.body: Find the pairs, rest your mind

list.0: You are doing better than you think.
list.1: Your body is working hard for you. Be gentle with it today.
list.2: Small steps still move you forward.
list.3: It’s okay to rest. Rest is part of getting better.
list.4: You don’t have to be perfect to be proud of yourself.
list.5: Bad days end. You have got through every one so far.
list.6: You deserve the same kindness you give others.
list.7: One glass of water, one deep breath, one small win.
list.8: Your worth isn’t measured by a number on any scale.
list.9: Today counts, even if all you did was keep going.
